svg.title: SignDuplex: compact proposed-method overview
svg.desc: Compact overview of the proposed SignDuplex method. Causal RGB, pose, and current system-state tokens are modeled by Qwen3-0.6B with LoRA. A unified five-event head predicts interaction events. The interaction controller routes receiving, responding, and user interruption. Based on the final paper method; only frames observed so far are used.
